name: Song of the Shire
game_text:
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert a <culture>Shire</culture> companion and either a <culture>Rohan</culture> companion or a <culture>Gandalf</culture> companion to add a <culture>Shire</culture> token here.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Remove a <culture>Shire</culture> token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
